questions.question: / consumer products. Describe the potential of India’s diverse resources in positioning India
questions.solution_html:
• Difference between tourism products and general consumer products .
  • Tourism products are intangible experiences such as travel
  • accommodation, and sightseeing that cannot be stored or owned, while
  • general consumer products are tangible goods that can be produced
  • stored, and physically possessed.
  • Tourism products depend on service quality and destination appeal
  • whereas consumer products depend on material quality and price.
questions.final_answer: whereas consumer products depend on material quality and price
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: / as a global tourism hub.
questions.solution_html:
• Potential of India’s diverse resources in positioning India as a global
  • tourism hub .
  • India’s diversity—ranging from natural landscapes (Himalayas, deserts
  • beaches) to cultural heritage (monuments, festivals, cuisines)—offers
  • varied experiences for tourists worldwide.
  • Its rich traditions, wildlife, spirituality, and modern facilities make India a
  • multi-dimensional destination, attracting international travellers.
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Write an essay on SIT and its importance in sustainable development.
questions.solution_html:
• Essay on SIT (Special Interest Tourism) and its importance in
  • sustainable development .
  • Special Interest Tourism (SIT) refers to travel motivated by a particular
  • passion or purpose, such as adventure, eco-tourism, wellness, heritage, or
  • culinary exploration. Unlike mass tourism, SIT focuses on smaller groups
  • and personalized experiences, allowing deeper interaction with local
  • culture and environment.
  • SIT plays a vital role in sustainable development by reducing over-tourism
  • in crowded destinations and promoting lesser-known regions. It
  • encourages community participation, protects natural and cultural
  • resources, and supports local economies through responsible travel. For
  • example, eco-tourism in national parks or cultural tourism in rural areas
  • helps preserve traditions while providing livelihoods.
questions.final_answer: helps preserve traditions while providing livelihoods
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025
